method: 8-factor robust-IQR nearest 60 same-stock daily analogs, uniform weights; current post-close premium transforms historical high/low/close outcomes. This is a counterfactual sensitivity, NOT overnight calibrated probabilities or executable backtest. OOS validates only unadjusted daily +5% high touch. No stop/target order inferable from daily bars.
